title: Flow role-axis registry
description: The party role names of a flow, each placed on the origin or destination axis. See schemas/registry/README.md. tools/validate_flow_role_axes.py checks sort order, uniqueness and the package mirror, which this schema cannot express.

format_version.description: The registry format's own version, pinned to the version this schema validates.

entries.description: Every flow role name, sorted by role.

role.description: The unique role name, spelled as the graph declares it.

axis.description: The flow axis the role sits on: origin where the flow starts, destination where it ends.
